assumptions: One uniform per attacking side: its goals, the opposing clean sheet and every conceded count are monotone reads of one draw.
Every term's mean is the projection's own term, so the scenario mean IS the published expected points up to sampling error.
The goal lambda is rebuilt each scenario from the lineup drawn, so a benched player scores none.
A clean sheet is never also charged for goals conceded, though p_cs and the opposing lambda are two different estimates of one quantity, so it can coincide with a non-zero drawn total.
Bonus is the projection's own proxy on the drawn returns, randomised-rounded; not a BPS model.
